scripts.save:sepolia: sh -c 'forge script script/DeploySepolia.s.sol:DeploySepolia --sig "save()" --rpc-url sepolia "$@" && node script/config/formatConfig.js' --
scripts.coverage:forge:report: forge coverage --report lcov --via-ir --exclude-tests --no-match-coverage 'script/' && lcov --remove lcov.info "*node_modules/*" --output-file lcov.info --rc lcov_branch_coverage=1 --ignore-errors inconsistent --ignore-errors unused && genhtml lcov.info --branch-coverage --output-dir coverage --ignore-errors inconsistent --ignore-errors unused
scripts.claude: DC_ARGS='--workspace-folder . --config .devcontainer/claude/devcontainer.json' && devcontainer up $DC_ARGS && devcontainer exec $DC_ARGS claude
scripts.devc:claude:update: docker rm -f devcontainer-cap-contracts-claude; DC_ARGS='--workspace-folder . --config .devcontainer/claude/devcontainer.json' && devcontainer up $DC_ARGS --build-no-cache
